dsp GenBlownPanWindyLow where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 1.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.003 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let breathIn := envA * (0.7 + colour * 0.3) + nz * (envA * 0.3 + chiffA * 0.3)
    let jetOut := softsign((breathIn - back * 0.55) * 2.5) - back * 0.3
    push bore := clip(jetOut * (0.5 + 0.42 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0)), -1.2, 1.2)
    let lpA := lp + 0.45 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA + nz * envA * 0.12) * 1.2
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.7164

dsp GenBlownPanWindyHigh where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 2.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.003 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let breathIn := envA * (0.7 + colour * 0.3) + nz * (envA * 0.3 + chiffA * 0.3)
    let jetOut := softsign((breathIn - back * 0.55) * 2.5) - back * 0.3
    push bore := clip(jetOut * (0.5 + 0.42 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0)), -1.2, 1.2)
    let lpA := lp + 0.45 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA + nz * envA * 0.12) * 1.2
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.7321

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0

  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.12 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 1.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.003 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let breathIn := envA * (0.7 + colour * 0.3) + nz * (envA * 0.03 + chiffA * 0.3)
    let jetOut := softsign((breathIn - back * 0.6) * 2.5) - back * 0.3
    push bore := clip(jetOut * (0.5 + 0.42 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0)), -1.2, 1.2)
    let lpA := lp + 0.45 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA + nz * envA * 0.012) * 1.2
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.0442

dsp GenBlownShakuhachiPureHigh where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.12 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 2.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.003 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let breathIn := envA * (0.7 + colour * 0.3) + nz * (envA * 0.03 + chiffA * 0.3)
    let jetOut := softsign((breathIn - back * 0.6) * 2.5) - back * 0.3
    push bore := clip(jetOut * (0.5 + 0.42 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0)), -1.2, 1.2)
    let lpA := lp + 0.45 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA + nz * envA * 0.012) * 1.2
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.9341

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.12 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 1.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.003 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let breathIn := envA * (0.7 + colour * 0.3) + nz * (envA * 0.12 + chiffA * 0.3)
    let jetOut := softsign((breathIn - back * 0.6) * 2.5) - back * 0.3
    push bore := clip(jetOut * (0.5 + 0.42 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0)), -1.2, 1.2)
    let lpA := lp + 0.45 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA + nz * envA * 0.048) * 1.2
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.8886

    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.7022

  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0

  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0

    let jetOut := softsign((breathIn - back * 0.6) * 2.5) - back * 0.3
    push bore := clip(jetOut * (0.5 + 0.42 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0)), -1.2, 1.2)
    let lpA := lp + 0.45 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA + nz * envA * 0.12) * 1.2
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.6678

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 1.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.003 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let breathIn := envA * (0.7 + colour * 0.3) + nz * (envA * 0.03 + chiffA * 0.3)
    let jetOut := softsign((breathIn - back * 0.35) * 2.5) - back * 0.3
    push bore := clip(jetOut * (0.5 + 0.42 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0)), -1.2, 1.2)
    let lpA := lp + 0.45 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA + nz * envA * 0.012) * 1.2
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.1452

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0

  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>

    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 2.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.003 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let breathIn := envA * (0.7 + colour * 0.3) + nz * (envA * 0.03 + chiffA * 0.3)
    let jetOut := softsign((breathIn - back * 0.35) * 2.5) - back * 0.3
    push bore := clip(jetOut * (0.5 + 0.42 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0)), -1.2, 1.2)
    let lpA := lp + 0.45 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA + nz * envA * 0.012) * 1.2
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.0578

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 1.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.003 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let breathIn := envA * (0.7 + colour * 0.3) + nz * (envA * 0.12 + chiffA * 0.3)
    let jetOut := softsign((breathIn - back * 0.35) * 2.5) - back * 0.3
    push bore := clip(jetOut * (0.5 + 0.42 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0)), -1.2, 1.2)
    let lpA := lp + 0.45 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA + nz * envA * 0.048) * 1.2
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.0349

dsp GenBlownOcarinaBreathyHigh where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 2.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.003 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let breathIn := envA * (0.7 + colour * 0.3) + nz * (envA * 0.12 + chiffA * 0.3)
    let jetOut := softsign((breathIn - back * 0.35) * 2.5) - back * 0.3
    push bore := clip(jetOut * (0.5 + 0.42 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0)), -1.2, 1.2)
    let lpA := lp + 0.45 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA + nz * envA * 0.048) * 1.2
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.9703

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0

    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.8364

dsp GenBlownBottleBreathyHigh where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 2.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.003 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let breathIn := envA * (0.7 + colour * 0.3) + nz * (envA * 0.12 + chiffA * 0.3)
    let jetOut := softsign((breathIn - back * 0.3) * 2.5) - back * 0.3
    push bore := clip(jetOut * (0.5 + 0.42 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0)), -1.2, 1.2)
    let lpA := lp + 0.45 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA + nz * envA * 0.048) * 1.2
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.0249

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0

  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>

    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 1.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.003 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let breathIn := envA * (0.7 + colour * 0.3) + nz * (envA * 0.03 + chiffA * 0.3)
    let jetOut := softsign((breathIn - back * 0.4) * 2.5) - back * 0.3
    push bore := clip(jetOut * (0.5 + 0.42 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0)), -1.2, 1.2)
    let lpA := lp + 0.45 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA + nz * envA * 0.012) * 1.2
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.0864

dsp GenBlownWhistlePureHigh where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 2.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.003 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let breathIn := envA * (0.7 + colour * 0.3) + nz * (envA * 0.03 + chiffA * 0.3)
    let jetOut := softsign((breathIn - back * 0.4) * 2.5) - back * 0.3
    push bore := clip(jetOut * (0.5 + 0.42 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0)), -1.2, 1.2)
    let lpA := lp + 0.45 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA + nz * envA * 0.012) * 1.2
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.9882

dsp GenBlownWhistleBreathyHigh where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 2.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.003 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let breathIn := envA * (0.7 + colour * 0.3) + nz * (envA * 0.12 + chiffA * 0.3)
    let jetOut := softsign((breathIn - back * 0.4) * 2.5) - back * 0.3
    push bore := clip(jetOut * (0.5 + 0.42 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0)), -1.2, 1.2)
    let lpA := lp + 0.45 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA + nz * envA * 0.048) * 1.2
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.9211

dsp GenBlownWhistleWindyLow where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 1.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.003 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let breathIn := envA * (0.7 + colour * 0.3) + nz * (envA * 0.3 + chiffA * 0.3)
    let jetOut := softsign((breathIn - back * 0.4) * 2.5) - back * 0.3
    push bore := clip(jetOut * (0.5 + 0.42 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0)), -1.2, 1.2)
    let lpA := lp + 0.45 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA + nz * envA * 0.12) * 1.2
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.8001

dsp GenBlownFifeBreathyLow where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 1.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.003 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let breathIn := envA * (0.7 + colour * 0.3) + nz * (envA * 0.12 + chiffA * 0.3)
    let jetOut := softsign((breathIn - back * 0.65) * 2.5) - back * 0.3
    push bore := clip(jetOut * (0.5 + 0.42 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0)), -1.2, 1.2)
    let lpA := lp + 0.45 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA + nz * envA * 0.048) * 1.2
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.6455

dsp GenBlownFifeBreathyHigh where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 2.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.003 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let breathIn := envA * (0.7 + colour * 0.3) + nz * (envA * 0.12 + chiffA * 0.3)
    let jetOut := softsign((breathIn - back * 0.65) * 2.5) - back * 0.3
    push bore := clip(jetOut * (0.5 + 0.42 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0)), -1.2, 1.2)
    let lpA := lp + 0.45 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA + nz * envA * 0.048) * 1.2
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.5212

dsp GenBlownFifeWindyLow where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 1.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.003 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let breathIn := envA * (0.7 + colour * 0.3) + nz * (envA * 0.3 + chiffA * 0.3)
    let jetOut := softsign((breathIn - back * 0.65) * 2.5) - back * 0.3
    push bore := clip(jetOut * (0.5 + 0.42 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0)), -1.2, 1.2)
    let lpA := lp + 0.45 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA + nz * envA * 0.12) * 1.2
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.5867

dsp GenBlownFifeWindyHigh where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state chiff : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.05 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let chiffA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, chiff * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set chiff := chiffA
    set vib := fract(vib + 4.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq * 2.0) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.003 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let breathIn := envA * (0.7 + colour * 0.3) + nz * (envA * 0.3 + chiffA * 0.3)
    let jetOut := softsign((breathIn - back * 0.65) * 2.5) - back * 0.3
    push bore := clip(jetOut * (0.5 + 0.42 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0)), -1.2, 1.2)
    let lpA := lp + 0.45 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA + nz * envA * 0.12) * 1.2
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.5253

reedClarinetSoftStill.source:
dsp GenReedClarinetSoftStill where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.5 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f * 0.5 - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let pressure := envA * (0.55 + colour * 0.4) + nz * envA * 0.02
    let diff := pressure - back * (0.0 - 1.0)
    let reedGain := clip(1.0 - diff * 0.6, -1.0, 1.0)
    push bore := clip(pressure - diff * reedGain, -1.0, 1.0) * (0.5 + 0.45 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0))
    let lpA := lp + 0.5 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.1
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 3.0000

reedClarinetReedyVibrato.source:
dsp GenReedClarinetReedyVibrato where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.5 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.005 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f * 0.5 - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let pressure := envA * (0.55 + colour * 0.4) + nz * envA * 0.02
    let diff := pressure - back * (0.0 - 1.0)
    let reedGain := clip(1.0 - diff * 0.9, -1.0, 1.0)
    push bore := clip(pressure - diff * reedGain, -1.0, 1.0) * (0.5 + 0.45 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0))
    let lpA := lp + 0.5 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.1
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.1669

dsp GenReedClarinetBrassyStill where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.5 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f * 0.5 - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let pressure := envA * (0.55 + colour * 0.4) + nz * envA * 0.02
    let diff := pressure - back * (0.0 - 1.0)
    let reedGain := clip(1.0 - diff * 1.3, -1.0, 1.0)
    push bore := clip(pressure - diff * reedGain, -1.0, 1.0) * (0.5 + 0.45 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0))
    let lpA := lp + 0.5 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.1
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.7974

reedChalumeauSoftStill.source:
dsp GenReedChalumeauSoftStill where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.5 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f * 0.5 - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let pressure := envA * (0.55 + colour * 0.4) + nz * envA * 0.02
    let diff := pressure - back * (0.0 - 1.0)
    let reedGain := clip(1.0 - diff * 0.6, -1.0, 1.0)
    push bore := clip(pressure - diff * reedGain, -1.0, 1.0) * (0.5 + 0.45 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0))
    let lpA := lp + 0.3 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.1
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 3.0000

dsp GenReedChalumeauReedyStill where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.5 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f * 0.5 - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let pressure := envA * (0.55 + colour * 0.4) + nz * envA * 0.02
    let diff := pressure - back * (0.0 - 1.0)
    let reedGain := clip(1.0 - diff * 0.9, -1.0, 1.0)
    push bore := clip(pressure - diff * reedGain, -1.0, 1.0) * (0.5 + 0.45 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0))
    let lpA := lp + 0.3 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.1
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.1704

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0

    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.5 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f * 0.5 - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let pressure := envA * (0.55 + colour * 0.4) + nz * envA * 0.02
    let diff := pressure - back * (0.0 - 1.0)
    let reedGain := clip(1.0 - diff * 1.3, -1.0, 1.0)
    push bore := clip(pressure - diff * reedGain, -1.0, 1.0) * (0.5 + 0.45 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0))
    let lpA := lp + 0.3 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.1
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.7996

reedOboeSoftStill.source:
dsp GenReedOboeSoftStill where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.5 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f * 1.0 - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let pressure := envA * (0.55 + colour * 0.4) + nz * envA * 0.02
    let diff := pressure - back
    let reedGain := clip(1.0 - diff * 0.6, -1.0, 1.0)
    push bore := clip(pressure - diff * reedGain, -1.0, 1.0) * (0.5 + 0.45 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0))
    let lpA := lp + 0.7 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.1
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 3.0000

reedOboeSoftVibrato.source:
dsp GenReedOboeSoftVibrato where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.5 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.005 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f * 1.0 - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let pressure := envA * (0.55 + colour * 0.4) + nz * envA * 0.02
    let diff := pressure - back
    let reedGain := clip(1.0 - diff * 0.6, -1.0, 1.0)
    push bore := clip(pressure - diff * reedGain, -1.0, 1.0) * (0.5 + 0.45 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0))
    let lpA := lp + 0.7 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.1
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 3.0000

reedOboeBrassyStill.source:
dsp GenReedOboeBrassyStill where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.5 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f * 1.0 - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let pressure := envA * (0.55 + colour * 0.4) + nz * envA * 0.02
    let diff := pressure - back
    let reedGain := clip(1.0 - diff * 1.3, -1.0, 1.0)
    push bore := clip(pressure - diff * reedGain, -1.0, 1.0) * (0.5 + 0.45 * min(1.0, envA * 3.0))
    let lpA := lp + 0.7 * (back - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.1
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 3.0000

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0

  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer bore : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))

    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.5 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.005 * envA)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f * 1.0 - 1.0)
    let back := taplin(bore, length)
    let pressure := envA * (0.55 + colour * 0.4) + nz * envA * 0.02

    set lp := lpA
    let pre := (lpA) * 1.1
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 3.0000
